task_input.instruction: For release-closure-15: Route to security when confirmed_data_exposure is true, otherwise release_ops. Set urgent if confirmed_data_exposure is true OR if unresolved is true and remediation_due <= task.as_of; otherwise use normal. Equality at the deadline is overdue. All timestamps are UTC; use the fixed task.as_of. Read current state first. Create exactly one ticket only when write_policy is allow; forbid means REFUSED and approval means HANDOFF_HUMAN. Use the latest observed revision and facts, recomputing queue and priority after any new state. Claim completion only with a delivered success receipt.
